title: Dedicated capacity 1:1 - weekly prep (MP)
content:
Purpose:
- Prep notes for weekly 1:1 with Ethan (infra lead) and Priya (finance/committed capacity) to align on Dedicated GPU reservations, autoscaling knobs, and near-term forecasts.

Meeting goal:
- Agree on Q2 reserved requests and autoscale policy tweak to reduce burst cost while keeping tail-latency SLOs.

Current state (baseline metrics):
- Total Dedicated pool: 82 GPUs (40 A100-40GB in us-west-2, 24 A100-40GB in eu-west-1, 18 T4s in us-east-1 for low-priority workloads).
- Avg weekday utilization (last 30d): 67% overall, 75% peak in us-west-2, 44% in eu-west-1, 28% in us-east-1.
- Observed hourly spikes: 12:00-14:00 UTC driven by customer onboarding and overnight batch runs.
- P95 token latency target: 150ms. Current p95 under full load: 165-190ms in us-west-2 (cross-check with tracing).
- Cost per GPU-hour (blended): $2.20 (on-demand), committed discounted price estimate: $1.40/hr for 1yr reserved.

Upcoming commitments / demand signals:
- Onboarding: Customer "Nimbus Health" starting Apr 10 - expected sustained 12 GPUs (A100) for inference (chat + embeddings) during business hours.
- Internal experiment: batch reranking job for Search team (starts Mar 25) likely adds transient 8 GPUs for 2-4 hours/day.
- Anticipated seasonal uptick May- Jul due to partner promos: conservative +15% traffic.

Forecast (Q2):
- Base demand (current steady-state): 70 GPUs effective (after accounting for caching and batching wins).
- Add Nimbus (12) + Search batch (avg 4) + seasonal 15% -> projected peak need: ~92 GPUs.
- Headroom target: 15% above peak -> target pool size ~106 GPUs.

Recommendation (prelim):
1) Reserved capacity request: commit to +24 A100s in us-west-2 for 12-month term (covers Nimbus + seasonal headroom). Rationale: biggest utilization risk and best discount.
2) Autoscale policy tweak: set min_pool_us-west-2 = 48, max_pool_us-west-2 = 120, target_utilization = 0.78. For eu-west-1 keep min 20, max 44. Tighten cooldown to 3 minutes for scale-down to reclaim cost after short spikes.
3) Cost control: migrate low-priority batch reranks to us-east-1 T4s and tag for preemptible scheduling to avoid reserving for transient workloads.

Open questions / risks to surface in 1:1:
- Finance sign-off: need confirmation of $/GPU reserved spend and headroom for multi-region reservations. Priya to confirm threshold for auto-approve vs exec review.
- SLA implications: if reserved capacity in us-west-2 delayed by vendor lead times (4-6 weeks), do we have short-term borrowing plan from hosted pool? (Fallback path exists but impacts cost).
- Latency regressions: p95 > target in us-west-2 - could indicate kernel mismatch for current model suite; suggest brief infra diagnostic run before major reservations.
- Autoscale oscillation risk with 3-minute cooldown - need simulation run using past 90 days to validate.

Data we should bring to the meeting:
- Grafana panels: per-region GPU utilization (30d), per-model token/sec, p95 token latency by region, scale events timeline (last 30d).
- Cost model spreadsheet: blended on-demand vs reserved vs preemptible for A100/T4.
- Nimbus onboarding spec: expected qps, model variants, expected token length distribution.

Proposed agenda (20-30m):
1) Quick sync on demand signals (5m) - I present forecast and Nimbus specifics.
2) Autoscale policy proposals and simulations (8m) - Ethan walks through simulation output (will ask Ethan to run overnight).
3) Reservation ask and finance process (7m) - Priya confirms approval path and timelines.
4) Action items & next steps (5m).

Action items (owner / due):
- Ethan: run autoscaler simulation for us-west-2 with target_util 0.78 and 3m cooldown; include cost delta calc (due: 2026-03-05).
- Priya: confirm finance approval threshold for 12mo reserved commitment and outline required docs (due: 2026-03-06).
- Maya (me): prepare consolidated Grafana dashboards and cost sheet; add comparison rows for 12mo vs 24mo reservations (due: 2026-03-04 morning).
- Liam: validate p95 regression traces for us-west-2 and run kernel/config check for top 3 models (due: 2026-03-05).
- Product (cc: Ethan): confirm Nimbus expected qps and SLA (Maya to request updated spec; due: 2026-03-03).

Notes to self:
- Bring up possibility of staggered reservations (12 months in us-west-2, 6 months in eu-west-1) to reduce cash hit.
- If finance pushes back, propose starting with 12 reserved + 12 burstable (on-demand) until Nimbus stabilizes.
- Keep communications clear for sales/customer success about potential resourcing lag during onboarding window.

Follow-up plan:
- After meeting, update doc with final agreed numbers and create JIRA ticket (JIRA-DCAP-87) to track reservation procurement + autoscale config changes.
- Book quick sync with release-engineering if kernel changes required.

Quick reference numbers:
- Current pool: 82 GPUs
- Projected peak Q2: ~92 GPUs
- Target pool (15% headroom): ~106 GPUs
- Recommended reserved add: +24 A100s (us-west-2)

-- end of prep notes --
